basis: The chart shows a clear and consistent downward trend in regional summer temperatures from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014, indicating a substantial change over the 10-year period. This significant decline justifies routing the change to substantial-change follow-up, as it deviates markedly from ordinary variation.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 summer temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
